primary_finding: Online health and E1.7 state updates occurred in completion callbacks, but the VM-mapper dispatch decisions never observed those updated states during the traced campaign.
interpretation: The health detector itself is capable of alarming on compute degradation; all recorded first health alarms in S2 and S4 were on truly affected nodes.
The service-based health detector cannot detect pure hidden network degradation in S3, so zero health alarms there are expected under the frozen detector definition.
E1.7's detector can trigger in many seeds, but eta remains 1.0 at every dispatch and no certification decision changes.

Because alarm_mask_at_dispatch and E1.7 state are never nonzero/active at any dispatch, the traced execution does not realize the intended online feedback loop between completed outcomes and later scheduling decisions.
This is an implementation/event-ordering diagnosis, not evidence that the locked thresholds should be tuned.
methodological_guardrail: Do not reinterpret E4.2 as passing and do not retune thresholds from these results. Any correction must be a new implementation-parity stage with predeclared invariants and exact reproduction checks.
